messages.subject: EURING 2021 Analytical Meeting - registration open
parts:
Hi (apologies for cross-postings),

The EURING Analytical Meeting focuses on the advancement of statistical
methods to estimate population parameters, with emphasis on the
analysis of marked individuals, mainly from ringing data, but also of
unmarked individuals. The 2021 edition of the meeting hosted by
Université Laval, QC, Canada will take place online from 31 May to 11
June, 2021. Daily 3 hour sessions will be at 10 am to 1 pm eastern
daylight time (UTC−04:00).

Registration for EURING 2021 is now open. You will find registration
information, a glimpse of the program, and the link to the registration
platform on the EURING 2021 web site:
http://www.phidot.org/euring/registration/

Note that early-bird registration closes on April 30th.

For additional information, you can check the EURING web site or
contact marc.ma...@sbf.ulaval.ca.

Sincerely,

Marc
